description: Send the ARTIST'S answer to a question Audora asked about their release (see get_release_questions). Ask the artist and relay what they say. Never answer for them and never guess: an answer can be a statement about rights or ownership that Audora relies on. Audora is told it came through their assistant. The release status does not change; Audora reads the answer and moves the release on.

answer.description: The artist's answer, in their words. Up to 4000 characters.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

dry_run.description: True to check the question is open, without sending anything.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the answer is sent once.

name: answer_release_question
title: Send the artist's answer to Audora
